name: Electromechanical Relay — 60V — DIP
description: This cluster contains 5 tier A electromechanical relay parts rated for 60V in DIP package families with SMD and through-hole footprint options.
selection_hints: Select between surface-mount (SMD) and through-hole mounting options.
Choose the appropriate footprint from DIP-4, SMDIP-4, DIP-6, or DIP-8 with 7.62mm width.
Select from 5 tier A representative parts including AQY282EH, AQY282EHA, TLP222A, TLP222A-2, and TLP3545.
avoid_when: The PCB layout requires package families other than DIP or SMDIP.
Footprints other than 4-pin, 6-pin, or 8-pin W7.62mm are required.
The application requires voltage specifications other than 60V.
